remarks: This apartment is located on the East Banks apartment building located directly on the Norwalk River. East Banks is a 12-unit apartment building with an elevator near the main lobby. Only three apartments per floor. This apartment is located on the first floor. The apartment is open and light-filled with views of the river from the living room and bedroom. Large bedroom with walk-in closet. Full bath can be accessed via the bedroom or from the living room. Laundry room in the actual apartment with full size washer and dryer. Central air and gas heat. Newer laminate floors in living room and bedroom. Two-month security deposit required. Tenant must have good credit and references. Tenant must have proof of adequate income to support the monthly rent. No pets- no exceptions. Apartment to be cleaned.
